decision: Retain finite world-predication fragment as unconfirmed exploratory proposal. Whole candidate is partial, not a complete C0 or a domain falsification.
limits: All 288 native positions are visible; UNKNOWN is not a null word.
At least okaiin and qokaiin have the same nonnull aN field/value effect in the prose fragments. Exact q additionally turns its predicate into condition.
Unknown preceding/intervening groups may alter ownership, field scope, time or conditions, so fragment bindings do not demonstrate continuous paragraph meaning.
Proposed dal/dalg values and .19 consumer are paid hypotheses. They do not identify a meaning or independently distinguish a static transition rival.
Ring IT lower FIELD is missing a written profile. ZL lower split o/ky cannot be joined to RF/IT oky. Every raw uncertainty remains.
Full Morgan historical source is not treated as a direct dictionary or measurement; no Moon-to-body bridge or efficacy claim is inferred.
No complete connected English reading can be honestly rendered while the listed unknowns remain.
